title: Multi-Turn Adaptive Prompting Attack on Large Vision-Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmarks measure the success rate of jailbreak attacks designed to elicit general harmful or malicious content.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on general-purpose jailbreak attacks against Large Vision-Language Models.
